title: Three Winters and One Short Frame
subtitle: 气候变化 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 气候变化（人与自然·环境保护·气候变化）
meta: 主题语境：气候变化（人与自然·环境保护·气候变化）　|　核心词汇：greenhouse　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 greenhouse 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1973 the gardener ① built a greenhouse that no neighbour on the plot would have described, and he said the building was the whole of the winter. The ② greenhouse, meaning the glasshouse itself and not the shed, ran three winters and stayed undescribed in the book; a greenhouse, he said, is the only thing on a plot that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ greenhouse on that plot had the same short frame beside it, and the ④ greenhouse at the far hedge, meaning the one they kept for the children and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A greenhouse, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the gardener said the describing is the part that fills three winters.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the greenhouse was the whole of the matter, meaning the warmth and not the glasshouse. The ⑥ greenhouse, meaning the warmth and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; greenhouse, he said, is either something you build or the only word that means both a glasshouse and a warmth. He said the warmth is the part they remember.

By 1978 the ⑦ greenhouse had become a line in a plan, and the plan had become an argument about the short frame. The ⑧ greenhouse of the whole thing, the gardener wrote in November, was one plot and three winters of describing; greenhouse, he said, is either the one at the far hedge or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ greenhouse I remember is the one described in the plan, which closed in 1980 and is still described as the quietest on the plot. A ⑩ greenhouse, my mother said in 1982, is the only one that improves by being described; every greenhouse, she said, is a warmth that has agreed to look like a glasshouse. She said the warmth was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 温室；暖房（指园子里每一座旁边的那一座）
B. n. 温室；暖房（指那座玻璃房本身，与棚屋相对）
C. 固定搭配：build a greenhouse 建一座温室
D. n. 温室（指留给孩子们用的那一座）
E. n. 温室（抽象总称，指一处园子的温室之事）
F. n. 温室（指方案里写到、被记录过的那一座）
G. n. 温暖；温室效应（the greenhouse effect，指一件事里人人都谈却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 暖意（抽象总称，指人人都谈却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: built a greenhouse that no neighbour on the plot would have described
The greenhouse, meaning the glasshouse itself and not the shed
the greenhouse at the far hedge
the greenhouse was the whole of the matter
the greenhouse had become a line in a plan
The greenhouse of the whole thing
A greenhouse, my mother said in 1982

answers.why: build a greenhouse 意为“建一座温室”，1973 年那位园丁建了园子里没有一位邻居肯描述的一座温室。
greenhouse 意为“温室、暖房”，指那座玻璃房本身而不是棚屋，它经过了三个冬天而在簿子上没有被描述。
greenhouse 意为“温室、暖房”，指园子里每一座旁边的那一座，每一座旁边都有同一个矮矮的框架。
greenhouse 意为“温室”，指最远那道树篱边留给孩子们用的那一座，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
greenhouse 意为“温暖、温室效应”，指一件事里人人都谈却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份温暖就是那件事的全部。
greenhouse 意为“暖意”，指人人都谈却无人提起的那样东西而不是那座温室，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
greenhouse 意为“温室”，指方案里写到、被记录过的那一座，到 1978 年这一座成了方案里的一行。
greenhouse 意为“温室”，园丁十一月写道，整件事的温室之事是一处园子和三个冬天的描述。
greenhouse 意为“温室”，我记得的是方案里描述过的那一座，1980 年拆了，至今仍被说成园子里最安静的一座。
greenhouse 为抽象总称，母亲 1982 年说，温室是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的建筑。
